Industrial Automation | Smart Factories | Predictive Maintenance | Industrial Data Flows

The elective covers IoT-enabled industrial automation, including sensors, controllers, machine communication, and Industry 4.0 concepts. Smart factories, predictive maintenance, and industrial data flows are explained.
